title: Metric registry frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of knowledge/metrics.md — the metric registry. Every logged metric has an entry; every entry maps the metric to its verification. Logging a new metric is preparing a new verification.

kind.description: primary = measures experiment quality (headline); proxy = correlates with primary but is not identical, used to localize what to improve; diagnostic = training health (grad_norm, loss by position, latent std, perf/*).

definition.description: What the metric computes, precisely enough to reimplement.

logged_by.description: Where in the code / which component emits it.

added_by.description: Provenance of the instrumentation change that introduced the metric.

verification.description: The check this metric backs. Defaults by kind: primary -> assertion (phase 4), proxy -> advisory, diagnostic -> band (phase 3) or analysis-only.

params.description: Checker parameters: band bounds, spike factor, patience, assertion pattern, tolerance.

references.description: Backfilled reference values with provenance, for grounding assertions when the metric did not exist at the reference run's time. Run records are never edited retroactively.

checkpoint.description: Which checkpoint the value was measured on.

value.description: Number, or array for vector metrics (e.g. per-position).

measured_at.description: Commit hash of the measuring code.
